candidate_source_binding: the additive fused kernel, count-18 same-binary primitive, runtime receipts, tests, custody inputs, and this predeclaration must be committed and pushed together before the first candidate performance sample

scope.stage: count-matched primitive screen only; a pass authorizes opt-in production plumbing but is not an end-to-end acceptance
scope.model_shape: Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B same-encoder linear-attention post-attention residual-to-RMS seams

excluded.standalone_linear_layer_bridge: not part of the accepted seven-command-buffer production path

production_call_mapping.qualification: source- and ledger-derived mapping of the accepted boundary/tail decode lane; not a performance counter

arms.A: existing linear_layer_residual_add dispatch, broad pair-local buffer barrier, existing linear_layer_rms_norm dispatch, and broad common consumer barrier
arms.B: one additive linear_layer_residual_rms_norm_fused_exact_v1 dispatch that materializes the residual, retains four f32 values per lane across the unchanged legacy nine-barrier reduction tree, and publishes normalized output, followed by the same broad common consumer barrier

exactness_driven_narrowing.selected_design: four retained residual values per lane with Clang floating-point reassociation disabled only in a nested compound around the final normalized-output product; the reduction remains under the existing compiler mode and the legacy shared tree is unchanged
exactness_driven_narrowing.pre_sampling_exactness_diagnosis: the unscoped default-fast-math formulation produced one-ULP target mismatches only in the final retained-value product; a nested '#pragma clang fp reassociate(off)' eliminated them in the full 18-row target regression before this predeclaration without changing following legacy kernel compilation
exactness_driven_narrowing.source_logical_residual_row_read_formula: 18 seams * 1024 f32 elements * 4 bytes * 2 legacy RMS reads
exactness_driven_narrowing.compiler_risk: four values remain live across nine barriers and final register allocation may spill; static threadgroup-memory metadata cannot attest private spills
exactness_driven_narrowing.reason: preserve target bit identity without compounding the previously rejected SIMD-tail reduction

count18_aggregate_primitive_topology.common_barrier_qualification: 17 barriers make the next dependent seam visible and one final symmetric trailing barrier mirrors the production consumer convention
count18_aggregate_primitive_topology.zero_timed_copy_qualification: zero explicit bridge memcpy inside the timed run, not zero GPU or shared-memory traffic

projected_production_topology_if_a_later.qualification: source/ledger projection only; no production integration exists at primitive-screen time

admission.primitive_harness_classification: always a non-formal diagnostic mechanism screen; it cannot promote or default a runtime path
admission.if_quiet_host_fails: complete the fixed schedule once only as explicitly non-formal diagnostic evidence

performance_continue_threshold.clearly_negative_block_definition: reject if either block has candidate latency improvement at or below -0.5 percent
performance_continue_threshold.result_if_passed: authorize additive opt-in production-profile plumbing and a separate predeclared end-to-end gate
performance_continue_threshold.result_if_failed: archive the fixed receipt and summary, then revert candidate implementation while retaining this predeclaration and the rejection evidence

fixed_fixture_and_schedule.fixture_shape: one H=1024 seed row plus 18 distinct H=1024 update rows per fixture; 18 distinct H=1024 weight rows shared across fixtures
fixed_fixture_and_schedule.generator: independently seeded deterministic dyadic xorshift64 streams encoded and hashed as little-endian f32 bits
fixed_fixture_and_schedule.warmup_block_1: ABBA with 64 consecutive count-18 aggregate calls per cell
fixed_fixture_and_schedule.warmup_block_2: BAAB with 64 consecutive count-18 aggregate calls per cell
fixed_fixture_and_schedule.timed_block_1: ABBA with 64 consecutive count-18 aggregate calls per cell
fixed_fixture_and_schedule.timed_block_2: BAAB with 64 consecutive count-18 aggregate calls per cell
fixed_fixture_and_schedule.timing: host monotonic elapsed time around one complete synchronous aggregate GPU call; fixture staging, poisoning, full-trace snapshots, custody checks, and JSON work are outside the timed region
fixed_fixture_and_schedule.primary_statistic: even median of raw call latencies per arm within each block and pooled per arm
